definitions.explanation: a formal proposal or recommendation made to a person of authority or an organization, often in business or government contexts

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{政策|せいさく}を{建|けん}{議|ぎ}する。
{委員|いいん}{会|かい}は{社長|しゃちょう}に{建|けん}{議|ぎ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}した。
examples.english: The committee submitted a proposal to the president.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}{削減|さくげん}について{建|けん}{議|ぎ}がなされた。
examples.english: A recommendation was made regarding budget cuts.

notes:
FORMAL REGISTER:
{建|けん}{議|ぎ} is a formal word typically used in:
- Government/administrative contexts
- Business/corporate settings
- Official recommendations to superiors

COMPARISON WITH SIMILAR WORDS:
- {建|けん}{議|ぎ} - formal proposal (to authority)
- {提案|ていあん} - proposal, suggestion (general)
- {提言|ていげん} - recommendation, proposal (formal)
- {意見|いけん} - opinion (general)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {建|けん}{議|ぎ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する - to submit a proposal
- {建|けん}{議|ぎ}{書|しょ} - written proposal/recommendation
- {建|けん}{議|ぎ}を{受|う}け{入|い}れる - to accept a proposal
